# Next.js Clean Architecture Convention v2

> Convention guide for structuring Next.js 15+ App Router projects.
> Stack: Next.js 15, TypeScript, shadcn/ui, Zustand, nuqs, TanStack Query, TanStack Form, Zod, next-intl.

## Folder Structure

- `messages/` — next-intl locale files (en.json, id.json) — at project root
- `src/app/[feature]/` — one directory per feature
- `src/app/[feature]/$action/` — Next.js Server Actions (ACT_ prefix)
- `src/app/[feature]/$element/` — React components (SE_ server, CE_ client)
- `src/app/[feature]/$function/` — helper functions (SFN_ server, CFN_ client)
- `src/app/[feature]/$store/` — Zustand stores scoped to this feature
- `src/api/[feature]/` — fetch wrappers per feature (APIS_ server-only, APIC_ client-accessible)
- `src/i18n/` — next-intl routing + request config
- `src/lib/[domain]/` — third-party adapters (index.ts interface + [library].ts impl)
- `src/reg/` — global constants: routes (ROUTE_), query keys (QK_)
- `src/store/` — global Zustand stores (used by 2+ features)

### API Layer

```
api/
├── [feature]/
│   ├── [resource].ts        fetch functions
│   └── [resource].type.ts   IRq_ and IRs_ interfaces
└── common.ts                shared headers, base fetcher, error handler
```

### Lib Layer

```
lib/
├── query-client.ts     TanStack Query client instance
├── session.ts          session management (get/set/clear cookie)
├── utils.ts            shared helpers (cn, format date, etc.)
└── [domain]/           external library abstraction
    ├── index.ts        interface + re-export of active implementation
    └── [library].ts    concrete implementation (ioredis, upstash, etc.)
```

### Registry

```
reg/
├── routes.register.ts      all path constants — ROUTE_
├── query-keys.register.ts  TanStack Query keys — QK_
└── [domain].register.ts    other domain constants
```

## Naming: Files

- Server Action: `action.[sub].ts`
- Server Element: `server.[module].tsx`
- Client Element: `client.[module].tsx`
- Server Function: `sfn.[module].ts`
- Client Function: `cfn.[module].ts`
- Zustand Store: `[module].store.ts`
- Zod Schema: `[module].schema.ts`
- API: `[resource].ts` + `[resource].type.ts`
- Lib adapter: `[library].ts` (impl) + `index.ts` (interface + re-export)
- i18n messages: `[locale].json` in `messages/` root

## Naming: Symbols

- ACT_ → Server Action (in $action/, "use server")
- SE_ → Server Element (Server Component)
- CE_ → Client Element ("use client")
- SFN_ → Server Function (server-only helper)
- CFN_ → Client Function (client-only helper)
- APIS_ → API fetch function — server-only (SE_, ACT_, SFN_ only)
- APIC_ → API fetch function — client-accessible (CE_ via TanStack Query)
- use[Name]Store → Zustand store hook
- ZS_ → Zod schema
- QK_ → TanStack Query key constant
- ROUTE_ → route path constant
- I_ → TypeScript interface (general)
- IRq_ → Request interface (API payload)
- IRs_ → Response interface (API response)
- T_ → Type alias
- E_ → Enum
- I_[Domain]Adapter → lib adapter interface

## Key Rules

- `page.tsx` must only render one SE_ component. No logic allowed.
- Never modify shadcn/ui components directly. Wrap them in CE_/lib.
- Use URL Search Params for search/filter/pagination state.
- Use Zustand only for transient UI state (modals, selections, toggles).
- GlobalEmitter is forbidden. Use Zustand or URL params instead.
- Server Actions must validate with Zod before calling APIS_.
- APIS_ can only be called from SE_, ACT_, SFN_. APIC_ is for CE_ via TanStack Query.
- All API response types use IRs_ prefix. All request types use IRq_.
- Unit tests are co-located next to the source file (e.g. client.form.test.tsx).
- Integration/E2E tests go in $test/ folder inside the feature folder.
- Never import external libraries directly — use adapters in lib/[domain]/.
- All user-facing strings use useTranslations (CE_) or getTranslations (SE_/SFN_).
- QK_ values must be defined in reg/query-keys.register.ts, not inline.
- ROUTE_ values must be defined in reg/routes.register.ts, not inline.

## Patterns

- Pattern A — Server fetch: page → SE_ → APIS_ → CE_ via props
- Pattern B — Client fetch: CE_ → useQuery(QK_, APIC_)
- Pattern C — Form submit: CE_ form (useForm/TanStack Form) → ACT_ (plain object) → Zod validate → APIS_
- Pattern D — Cross-component (persistent): useQueryState (nuqs) → page re-render → SE_ baca
- Pattern E — Cross-component (transient): useXxxStore from $store/ or store/
- Pattern F — shadcn/ui extension: wrap in CE_ or lib/, never modify components/ui/
- Pattern G — Library adapter: lib/[domain]/index.ts (interface) + lib/[domain]/[library].ts (impl)
- Pattern H — i18n: messages/[locale].json namespaced by feature; useTranslations/getTranslations

## Git Commits

Conventional Commits: <type>(<scope>): <description>
Types: feat, fix, docs, refactor, chore, test, perf, style

---

## Code Examples

### Pattern A — Server Fetch

Data needed on first render, no interactivity required.

```
page.tsx → SE_ component → APIS_ → data → CE_ via props
```

```tsx
// page.tsx
export default async function Page({ searchParams }) {
    const params = await searchParams
    return <SE_UserList searchParams={params} />
}

// $element/server.userlist.tsx
export async function SE_UserList({ searchParams }) {
    const data = await APIS_GetUsers({ search: searchParams.search })
    return <CE_UserTable data={data.items} total={data.total} />
}

// $element/client.usertable.tsx
"use client"
export function CE_UserTable({ data, total }: { data: I_User[], total: number }) {
    return <Table data={data} />
}
```

---

### Pattern B — Client Fetch (TanStack Query)

Data needs refresh without navigation, polling, or depends on user interaction.

```
CE_ component → useQuery(QK_, APIC_) → render
```

```tsx
// reg/query-keys.register.ts
export const QK_UserList = (search: string) => ["user", "list", search]

// $element/client.userlist.tsx
"use client"
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query"
import { QK_UserList } from "@/reg/query-keys.register"
import { APIC_GetUsers } from "@/api/user/list"

export function CE_UserList({ search }: { search: string }) {
    const { data, isLoading } = useQuery({
        queryKey: QK_UserList(search),
        queryFn: () => APIC_GetUsers({ search }),
    })

    if (isLoading) return <Skeleton />
    return <Table data={data?.items ?? []} />
}
```

---

### Pattern C — Form Submit (TanStack Form + Zod + Server Action)

All form submissions — create, update, delete.

```
CE_ form (useForm) → onSubmit → ACT_ (plain object) → Zod safeParse → APIS_ → redirect/error
```

```tsx
// [feature].schema.ts
import { z } from "zod"

export const ZS_LoginForm = z.object({
    email: z.string().email("Invalid email format"),
    password: z.string().min(8, "Password must be at least 8 characters"),
})

// $action/action.submit.ts
"use server"
import { redirect } from "next/navigation"
import { ZS_LoginForm } from "../login.schema"
import type { IRq_Login } from "@/api/auth/login.type"

export async function ACT_SubmitLogin(data: IRq_Login) {
    const parsed = ZS_LoginForm.safeParse(data)
    if (!parsed.success) return { error: parsed.error.flatten().fieldErrors }

    const result = await APIS_Login(parsed.data)
    if (!result.ok || !result.data) return { error: { _root: [result.message] } }

    await SFN_SaveSession(result.data.token)
    redirect("/dashboard")
}

// $element/client.form.tsx
"use client"
import { useForm } from "@tanstack/react-form"
import { zodValidator } from "@tanstack/zod-form-adapter"
import { ACT_SubmitLogin } from "../$action/action.submit"
import { ZS_LoginForm } from "../login.schema"

export function CE_LoginForm() {
    const form = useForm({
        defaultValues: { email: "", password: "" },
        validators: { onSubmit: ZS_LoginForm },
        validatorAdapter: zodValidator(),
        onSubmit: async ({ value }) => {
            await ACT_SubmitLogin(value)
        },
    })

    return (
        <form onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); form.handleSubmit() }}>
            <form.Field name="email">
                {(field) => (
                    <>
                        <input
                            type="email"
                            value={field.state.value}
                            onChange={(e) => field.handleChange(e.target.value)}
                            onBlur={field.handleBlur}
                        />
                        {field.state.meta.errors[0] && (
                            <p>{field.state.meta.errors[0].toString()}</p>
                        )}
                    </>
                )}
            </form.Field>
            <form.Field name="password">
                {(field) => (
                    <>
                        <input
                            type="password"
                            value={field.state.value}
                            onChange={(e) => field.handleChange(e.target.value)}
                            onBlur={field.handleBlur}
                        />
                        {field.state.meta.errors[0] && (
                            <p>{field.state.meta.errors[0].toString()}</p>
                        )}
                    </>
                )}
            </form.Field>
            <form.Subscribe selector={(s) => [s.canSubmit, s.isSubmitting]}>
                {([canSubmit, isSubmitting]) => (
                    <button type="submit" disabled={!canSubmit || isSubmitting}>
                        {isSubmitting ? "Processing..." : "Login"}
                    </button>
                )}
            </form.Subscribe>
        </form>
    )
}
```

---

### Pattern D — Cross-component State via URL Search Params

Search, filter, pagination — state that should be shareable and bookmarkable.

```
CE_SearchBar → useQueryState (nuqs) → page re-render → SE_ reads → new data
```

```tsx
// $element/client.searchbar.tsx
"use client"
import { useQueryState } from "nuqs"
import { useDebouncedCallback } from "use-debounce"

export function CE_SearchBar() {
    const [search, setSearch] = useQueryState("q", { defaultValue: "", shallow: false })

    const handleSearch = useDebouncedCallback((term: string) => {
        setSearch(term || null)
    }, 300)

    return (
        <input
            defaultValue={search}
            onChange={(e) => handleSearch(e.target.value)}
        />
    )
}
```

> `shallow: false` ensures param changes trigger Server Component re-render.
> For multiple params (search + page + filter), use `useQueryStates` from nuqs.

---

### Pattern E — Cross-component State via Zustand

Transient state not needed in URL — modal open, selected row, sidebar toggle, notifications.

```
CE_A dispatch → store → CE_B subscribe → re-render
```

```ts
// $store/ui.store.ts
import { create } from "zustand"

interface I_UIStore {
    selectedId: string | null
    isModalOpen: boolean
    setSelectedId: (id: string | null) => void
    openModal: () => void
    closeModal: () => void
}

export const useUIStore = create<I_UIStore>((set) => ({
    selectedId: null,
    isModalOpen: false,
    setSelectedId: (id) => set({ selectedId: id }),
    openModal: () => set({ isModalOpen: true }),
    closeModal: () => set({ isModalOpen: false, selectedId: null }),
}))
```

```tsx
// CE_Table — dispatch
const { setSelectedId, openModal } = useUIStore()
<button onClick={() => { setSelectedId(row.id); openModal() }}>Detail</button>

// CE_DetailModal — subscribe
const { selectedId, isModalOpen, closeModal } = useUIStore()
```

---

### Pattern F — shadcn/ui Extension

Never modify components in `components/ui/` directly. Always wrap.

```tsx
// lib/button.tsx — shared wrapper over shadcn Button
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

export function AppButton({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof Button>) {
    return <Button className={cn("rounded-lg", className)} {...props} />
}

// $element/client.savebutton.tsx — feature-specific wrapper
"use client"
import { AppButton } from "@/lib/button"

export function CE_SaveButton({ onSave }: { onSave: () => void }) {
    return <AppButton onClick={onSave}>Save</AppButton>
}
```

---

### Pattern G — Library Adapter

Every external library integration must be wrapped in an adapter.

```ts
// lib/cache/index.ts — interface + export of active implementation
export interface I_CacheAdapter {
    get(key: string): Promise<string | null>
    set(key: string, value: string, ttlSeconds?: number): Promise<void>
    del(key: string): Promise<void>
}

export { cache } from "./ioredis"

// lib/cache/ioredis.ts — concrete implementation
import { Redis } from "ioredis"
import type { I_CacheAdapter } from "."

const client = new Redis(process.env.REDIS_URL!)

export const cache: I_CacheAdapter = {
    get: (key) => client.get(key),
    set: (key, value, ttl) =>
        ttl
            ? client.set(key, value, "EX", ttl).then(() => {})
            : client.set(key, value).then(() => {}),
    del: (key) => client.del(key).then(() => {}),
}

// Consumer — does not need to know which library is used
// $function/sfn.session.ts
import { cache } from "@/lib/cache"

export async function SFN_SaveSession(token: string) {
    await cache.set(`session:${token}`, token, 3600)
}
```

To swap ioredis → upstash: create `lib/cache/upstash.ts`, update the re-export in `index.ts`. Done.

---

### Pattern H — i18n with next-intl

All user-facing text — labels, error messages, placeholders.

```json
// messages/en.json
{
  "Login": {
    "title": "Sign In",
    "email": "Email",
    "password": "Password",
    "submit": "Sign In",
    "error": {
      "invalidCredentials": "Invalid email or password"
    }
  }
}
```

```tsx
// CE_ — Client Component
"use client"
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl"

export function CE_LoginForm() {
    const t = useTranslations("Login")
    return (
        <form>
            <label>{t("email")}</label>
            <button>{t("submit")}</button>
        </form>
    )
}

// SE_ — Server Component
import { getTranslations } from "next-intl/server"

export async function SE_LoginLayout() {
    const t = await getTranslations("Login")
    return <h1>{t("title")}</h1>
}
```

> Never use a `$lang/` folder inside feature directories.
> Never use a `LANG_` prefix — replaced by `useTranslations` / `getTranslations`.

---

---

## Example Use Case

Real-world examples showing how multiple patterns combine in one feature.

---

### Example 1 — Landing Page Bilingual

Patterns: A (server fetch) + F (shadcn extension) + H (i18n)

```
app/[locale]/
├── page.tsx                   → only: return <SE_LandingLayout />
└── $element/
    ├── server.layout.tsx      SE_LandingLayout
    ├── server.hero.tsx        SE_HeroSection — async, APIS_GetActivePromo + getTranslations
    ├── client.navbar.tsx      CE_Navbar — useTranslations + language switcher
    └── client.cta-button.tsx  CE_CTAButton — wraps shadcn Button, never modifies it
api/promo/active.ts            APIS_GetActivePromo → IRs_ActivePromo
messages/en.json + id.json     namespace "Landing"
```

```tsx
// SE_HeroSection — Pattern A + H combined
export async function SE_HeroSection() {
    const promo = await APIS_GetActivePromo()   // Pattern A: APIS_ fetch on server
    const t = await getTranslations("Landing")  // Pattern H: SE_ uses getTranslations
    return <CE_CTAButton href={promo.ctaUrl}>{t("hero.cta")}</CE_CTAButton>
}

// CE_Navbar — Pattern H client-side
"use client"
export function CE_Navbar() {
    const t = useTranslations("Landing")        // Pattern H: CE_ uses useTranslations
    const router = useRouter()
    // language switcher: router.replace(pathname, { locale: next })
}

// CE_CTAButton — Pattern F
"use client"
export function CE_CTAButton({ href, children }: I_CTAButtonProps) {
    return <Button asChild className="rounded-full px-8"><a href={href}>{children}</a></Button>
    // wraps shadcn Button — never touches components/ui/button.tsx
}
```

---

### Example 2 — User Management

Patterns: A + B + C + D + E + H

```
app/user-management/
├── page.tsx                      → only: return <SE_UserManagementLayout searchParams={params} />
├── $action/action.create.ts      ACT_CreateUser — "use server", ZS_ validate → APIS_
├── $element/
│   ├── server.layout.tsx         SE_UserManagementLayout — async, APIS_GetUsers + getTranslations
│   ├── client.searchbar.tsx      CE_SearchBar — router.replace(?search=...) Pattern D
│   ├── client.table.tsx          CE_UserTable — useQuery(QK_UserList) Pattern B + Zustand dispatch
│   ├── client.create-modal.tsx   CE_CreateModal — useActionState(ACT_CreateUser) Pattern C + Zustand subscribe
│   └── client.pagination.tsx     CE_Pagination — router.replace(?page=...) Pattern D
└── $store/ui.store.ts            useUserManagementStore — isModalOpen, selectedId Pattern E
api/user-management/users.ts      APIS_GetUsers, APIS_CreateUser
reg/query-keys.register.ts        QK_UserList
```

```tsx
// SE_UserManagementLayout — Pattern A: fetch on server, pass to CE_ via props
export async function SE_UserManagementLayout({ searchParams }) {
    const data = await APIS_GetUsers({ search: searchParams.search, page: Number(searchParams.page) || 1 })
    return <CE_UserTable initialData={data} />
}

// CE_UserTable — Pattern B: useQuery refetches after mutation without navigation
export function CE_UserTable({ initialData }: { initialData: IRs_UserList }) {
    const { data } = useQuery({ queryKey: QK_UserList({ search, page }), queryFn: () => APIS_GetUsers(...), initialData })
    const { setSelectedId, openModal } = useUserManagementStore() // Pattern E: dispatch to Zustand
}

// ACT_CreateUser — Pattern C: ZS_ validate → APIS_, then invalidate QK_
"use server"
export async function ACT_CreateUser(_: unknown, formData: FormData) {
    const parsed = ZS_CreateUser.safeParse({ name: formData.get("name"), ... })
    if (!parsed.success) return { error: parsed.error.flatten().fieldErrors }
    await APIS_CreateUser(parsed.data)
    revalidateTag("users")
}

// CE_SearchBar — Pattern D: write to URL, SE_ reads on re-render
export function CE_SearchBar() {
    const handleSearch = useDebouncedCallback((term) => {
        router.replace(`?search=${term}&page=1`)  // SE_ akan re-render dengan data baru
    }, 300)
}

// useUserManagementStore — Pattern E: transient state for modal + selected row
export const useUserManagementStore = create<I_UserManagementStore>((set) => ({
    isModalOpen: false, selectedId: null,
    openModal: () => set({ isModalOpen: true }),
    closeModal: () => set({ isModalOpen: false, selectedId: null }),
}))
```

---

### Example 3 — Form Wizard

Patterns: C + E + F + H

```
app/onboarding/
├── page.tsx                         → only: return <SE_OnboardingLayout />
├── $action/action.submit.ts         ACT_SubmitOnboarding — re-validates ZS_ on server
├── $element/
│   ├── server.layout.tsx            SE_OnboardingLayout
│   ├── client.wizard.tsx            CE_Wizard — reads currentStep from useWizardStore
│   ├── client.step-personal.tsx     CE_StepPersonal — useForm + ZS_PersonalStep + savePersonal()
│   ├── client.step-company.tsx      CE_StepCompany — useForm + ZS_CompanyStep + saveCompany()
│   ├── client.step-review.tsx       CE_StepReview — reads store, calls ACT_SubmitOnboarding
│   └── client.step-indicator.tsx    CE_StepIndicator — wraps shadcn Progress Pattern F
├── $function/cfn.validate.ts        ZS_PersonalStep, ZS_CompanyStep, T_PersonalStep, T_CompanyStep
└── $store/wizard.store.ts           useWizardStore — currentStep, personal, company
```

```ts
// useWizardStore — Pattern E: single source of truth for all wizard state
export const useWizardStore = create<I_WizardStore>((set) => ({
    currentStep: 1, personal: {}, company: {},
    savePersonal: (data) => set({ personal: data, currentStep: 2 }), // save + advance in one action
    saveCompany: (data) => set({ company: data, currentStep: 3 }),
}))

// CE_StepPersonal — Pattern C + E: validate with ZS_, save to store on success
export function CE_StepPersonal() {
    const { savePersonal, personal } = useWizardStore()  // pre-fill from store (back navigation)
    const form = useForm({
        defaultValues: { fullName: personal.fullName ?? "", ... },
        onSubmit: async ({ value }) => {
            const parsed = ZS_PersonalStep.safeParse(value)  // ZS_ prefix — Zod schema
            if (!parsed.success) return
            savePersonal(parsed.data)  // Pattern E: advance step via store
        },
    })
}

// ACT_SubmitOnboarding — Pattern C: re-validate on server, never trust client only
"use server"
export async function ACT_SubmitOnboarding(payload: { personal: unknown; company: unknown }) {
    const personal = ZS_PersonalStep.safeParse(payload.personal)  // re-validate
    const company = ZS_CompanyStep.safeParse(payload.company)
    if (!personal.success || !company.success) return { error: "Data tidak valid" }
    await APIS_SubmitOnboarding({ ...personal.data, ...company.data })
    redirect("/dashboard")
}

// CE_StepIndicator — Pattern F: extend shadcn Progress without modifying components/ui/
export function CE_StepIndicator({ current, total }: I_StepIndicatorProps) {
    const percentage = (current / total) * 100
    return <Progress value={percentage} />  // shadcn Progress — wrapped, not modified
}
```
